steps: Combine Rice and Water in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes, until water is absorbed.
Spread the cooked Rice onto a lined tray and press into a 1 cm-thick layer; let cool 10 minutes.
Wash and peel the Cucumber; slice into 20 rounds, each about 1 cm thick.
In a small bowl, stir the Ricotta, Fresh dill, and Lemon juice together until smooth.
Cut the cooled rice layer into 20 small rounds using a 4 cm round cutter.
Spoon about 1 teaspoon of the Ricotta mixture onto each rice round.
Top each round with one Cucumber slice and press gently to secure.
Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days; serve cold.
